description: Pinned OCR models used by Konvert (text recognition of scanned PDFs and pictures). Downloaded only at development/build time by scripts/setup-ocr.mjs, verified with SHA-256, never at runtime. To upgrade: pick new ONNX files, update urls/sha256/size, run the setup script and the test suite.
name: PaddleOCR PP-OCRv5 mobile (text detection) and Latin PP-OCRv5 mobile (text recognition)
